intro_html: All the fun of pizza night, none of the delivery fee. Turkey pepperoni, high-protein rotini, marinara, and gooey mozzarella bake up into a bowl the kids will actually ask for again. It reheats great, it costs about $1.20 a serving (at everyday cost), and it scratches the pizza itch without the twenty-dollar order.
cost_closing_html: About $1.20 a bowl (at everyday cost) for pizza-night flavor. A large delivery pizza runs $18 or more, so this is one of the easiest swaps on the menu.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. Divide that total by 14 and scoop the exact amount into each container. Every bowl lands near 396 calories and 28 grams of protein.
upsell_html: Pizza-night dinners for about $1.20 a bowl (at everyday cost). This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Turkey pepperoni beats regular on macros. It brings the same pizza flavor with less fat, which is why it earns its spot here.
Protein pasta or regular, your call. Regular rotini is a bit cheaper. The protein version adds a few grams per serving for about the same price.
Buy shredded cheese in the bigger bag and check the price per ounce. The store brand melts just as well.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Boil the rotini to al dente per the box, then drain.
Warm the marinara in a large skillet and stir in most of the pepperoni, saving a little to top the bowls.
Add the drained pasta and stir to coat.
Fold in the mozzarella off the heat until melty, then scatter the reserved pepperoni on top.

head.description: A kid-friendly turkey pepperoni, protein pasta, marinara, and mozzarella meal prep. Fourteen servings at about 396 calories and 28 grams of protein for roughly $1.20 each (at everyday cost).
head.keywords: cheap meal prep, pizza pasta, kid friendly meal prep, high protein pasta, budget dinner
recipeIngredient: 2 bags (8 oz each) Reduced Fat Mozzarella
steps: Boil the rotini to al dente and drain.
Warm the marinara with most of the pepperoni in a large skillet.
Add the drained pasta and stir to coat.
Fold in the mozzarella off the heat and top with the reserved pepperoni.
Weigh the batch and divide into 14 containers.
